reaction: It was satisfying to see the receiving and sending parts come together, though the supporting cells and fatty coverings appeared without much explanation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the signalling ends was most worthwhile: the panels showed a signal reaching the ending and messengers crossing the gap, making their job clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the receiving branches was straightforward and predictable from their matching shapes, so it offered less to figure out.

surprise.text: The finished nervous tissue included supporting cells and fatty fibre coverings that we hadn't assembled separately; their jobs weren't explained.

arbitrary.text: No chosen action felt arbitrary: the pictures or goals explained each pairing, even when the next step was obvious.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter to see how the nervous tissue connects to other body parts. The message pathway was understandable enough to make me curious.
